description: A light gray T‑shirt is on a red bedspread in front of a white pillow. The left hand and right hand reach in and grasp the shirt as a two-hand object, lift and spread it flat, then the right hand pulls one side inward and the left hand smooths and aligns the edges; both hands fold it lengthwise into a long strip, then lift and refold it into a smaller rectangle and set it down before adjusting the corners.
